albedo.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production seamless ALBEDO/base-color texture for a stylized top-down 3D puzzle game, raw quarry-cut MARBLE. Create ONE full-bleed square opaque 1024x1024 material texture, viewed exactly orthographically, flat and evenly illuminated. This is a color map, not a render of a wall, not a photograph of a quarry. It will be applied to already modeled irregular rectangular wall stones.

Style: simplified hand-painted low-poly fantasy-game stone, the same broad angular painted color patches, softly stippled mineral grain, restrained contrast and quiet matte fields used for painterly sandstone ground textures. Preserve the identity of marble: pale gray/off-white cream main mass around sRGB #D2D4CD and #BEC6C8, lighter ivory #E1DFD4, soft diluted cool-gray clouding #A7B3B6. 75-80% quiet broad areas. Across the entire tile use about four to six irregular long broken mineral runs, mostly gently diagonal/vertical, in muted blue-gray #68757A / #849095, with very sparse finer charcoal #59656A accents. A few soft cloudy gray bands and tiny fissure branches, not dense black spiderweb. Veins vary in thickness with occasional angular kinks; main thin lines roughly 0.5-1% image width, surrounding diluted bands broader. Raw crystalline limestone/marble look, subdued rather than polished decorative countertop. Faint quarry saw strokes mostly vertical, simplified and low contrast. Tiny occasional warm ochre weathering streaks #A18B63/#B9AA87 covering only 2-3% of area.

Seamless horizontal and vertical repeat: all opposite edges and all four corners must connect naturally. Continuous diffuse surface throughout, no separate slab/block shapes or masonry outlines, no grout, no terrain plate borders, no single focal subject, no gradients. Albedo ONLY: no directional light, no cast shadows, no specular highlights, no ambient occlusion or cavity black shadows, no bevel shading, no glossy finish, no harsh dark cracks. No moss, plants, characters, sky, mountain, quarry scene, letters, legend, watermarks, panels or margins. Keep the painted vein and grain detail sparse enough to read on small game tiles.

height.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: aligned PBR HEIGHT source for a stylized raw quarry-marble game material. The input image is the exact layout reference and edit target. Convert this ONE seamless square marble albedo to a SINGLE pure grayscale 1024x1024 height image, preserving every mineral run, cloudy patch, faint saw mark, fissure and grain feature's exact position, scale, silhouette and orientation. Do not add, remove, move or redraw any feature. Seamless repeat in both axes and matching opposite edges/corners. Gray intensity must represent physical surface height ONLY: most broad marble fields almost completely flat around middle gray #808080, hairline fissures gently recessed around #727272, sparse crystalline granular facets and fine shallow quarry saw relief around #858585. Broad gray mineral/color bands should stay essentially coplanar rather than becoming deep grooves. Surface is raw marble with shallow worn microfacets, not cobbles or relief-carved veins. Keep 85 percent quiet near midgray, narrow gentle relief, no black/white clipping and no large height gradients. Strip ALL color, directional illumination, cast shadows, highlights and AO; height is not simply grayscale brightness from albedo. Full bleed orthographic flat surface, one image, no rendered scene, labels, frame, text, panels, normal-map colors or other outputs.
